reviewed_by: Claude Code, after diagnosing a replaced API that stayed draining on live Core (root cause independently validated by a fresh subagent)
reason: A promoted-away API is now retired by the supervisor once API_DRAIN_GRACE_MS (60 s) has passed, and deployment status no longer degrades on a replaced API within API_DRAIN_BOUND_MS (180 s) but does past it. Selected: test_api_candidate_retirement.py (new regressions: a draining API with an open stream is kept within grace then retired with its proxied streams closed and the promoted API never retired; health stays ready during the drain and degrades past the bound; a refused retirement keeps the row; an open SSE stream cannot hold the worker server past graceful shutdown; plus the existing prepare_api retirement guards), test_deployment_lifecycle.py (promotion, retirement, status health), test_supervisor.py (supervisor operations and loop), test_runtime_management.py (the operator retire action; also enables the CI PostgreSQL runtime).
exclusions: test_api_worker.py, test_api_worker_composition.py, test_deployment_inventory_reads.py, test_runtime_worker_features.py and tests/test_simulation_host_activation.py were run locally and pass except two cases that fail identically on pristine origin/main for environmental reasons (a subprocess without the nebula package on its path, and a deployer test that resolves /srv/apple-sim on this host); they do not exercise the changed paths beyond what the selection covers. test_chat.py is not selected because its [postgresql] case fails on main in CI. No UI, setting or operator workflow changed, so no frontend, Playwright or LAN-instance journey applies.
